title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Stocks bounced back Fri, Dow +1% (~518pts) to 53,277, S&P 500 +0.43% to 7,674, Nasdaq +0.43% to 26,180
Yields: 30-yr Treasury near decade highs at ~5.28%, 10-yr ~4.74%, despite Bessent doubling long-bond buybacks to $4B+/operation
Crypto: Bitcoin surged 22% on the week, briefly neared $80k, on Trump's push for crypto-friendly CLARITY Act; Robinhood +14%, Coinbase +8% on the week
Gold/Silver: Gold hit a 3-month high, +5.6% this week to $4,624/oz; silver also on a 3-week win streak
Companies: Walmart down ~10% on the week after its slowest sales growth in 6+ years
Companies: Moderna/Merck mRNA cancer treatment data has investors rushing back into biotech
Macro/Policy: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh convening task forces to rethink inflation approach; speaks at Jackson Hole next Thu-Sat
Ahead: Nvidia, Salesforce, CrowdStrike, HP, Okta earnings next week; Q2 GDP (2nd est.) and PCE inflation data due
